1.context: Faith is the instrument, the channel by which we receive the grace of God. Was this a human setup, this notion of salvation by grace through faith? No. For Paul goes on to say, This is not your own doing, it is the gift of God, not because of works, lest any man should boast. So it is through placing our faith in God, or specifically in Christ, that we appropriate the atoning death of Christ on our behalf and so receive God's grace.
